import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,"/workspace/dev")
import gen, gen2, gen3, gen4
from collections import Counter
stat = Counter()
for name, mod, n in (("gen",gen,300),("gen2",gen2,120),("gen3",gen3,300),("gen4",gen4,119)):
    for s in range(1,n+1):
        doc = mod.gen(s)
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"submission/main.py"], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True)
        d = json.loads(p.stdout)
        assert "packets" in d, (name, s)
        for x in d["packets"]: stat[x["decision"]] += 1
        for j in d["jobs"]: stat["job:"+j["status"]] += 1
        stat["inputs"] += 1
        stat["pkts"] += len(d["packets"])
        stat["nolenull"] += sum(1 for c in d["connections"] if c["prediction"] is None)
        for r in ("dev","eval"):
            if d["reports"][r]["connections"] > 0:
                mf = d["reports"][r]["macro_f1"]
                stat["macro_%s_%s"%(r,"zero" if mf[0]==0 else "nz")] += 1
                stat["denom%d"%mf[1]] += 1
print(dict(stat))
PYEOF
